_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows tactica.'s track record card to the user. Don't repeat its numbers; reply with one or two sentences of insight.

description: Free. For "is tactica. any good?" or "what's your record?" on Premier League, Championship, League 1 or League 2 picks. tactica.'s settled-pick track record: overall results and 1-unit profit, broken down by market, league and tier, with the running total and an observedAt time. Use this when you want to judge tactica.'s results before buying picks. Use get_settled_record instead for the individual settled picks. Free, no payment. Read-only; covers every pick settled to date. No parameters.

detail.description: Optional. full returns every number as data, even when the app shows a tactica. card. Example: full

name: get_track_record
title: Get the track record
